title: Watch as ‘alien jellyfish-like UFO’ is spotted hovering near US military base before vanishing
description: Another unidentified flying object (UFO) sighting has emerged in the United States amid an ongoing government effort to declassify and release records on unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAPs).

title: Three minutes, no answers: jellyfish-like UFO spotted near America's key F-22 base?
description: A mysterious, jellyfish-like object with dangling, tentacle-shaped extensions has reportedly been spotted hovering over Anchorage, Alaska, in the direction of a major US military installation. Witness Sara Jane Osborn says she was photographing a rainbow with her husband on June 15 when the strange object appeared above the treeline. It reportedly hovered, shifted from side to side and vanished after roughly three minutes. The sighting has drawn attention because Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, which operates F-22 Raptor fighter jets, is nearby. But is it a drone, kite or something else? No link to the military or extraterrestrial origin has been established.
